title: Hypothetical nuclear-principle electromagnetic power source whose load can't be controlled

tellings.quote: >> hypothetically, if you have an electromagnetic power source that probably operates off of nuclear principles and it gives off energy and you can't control the load,

plain: Dylan Borland, who says a top government official told him aliens run everything, puts forward a 'hypothetically': a power source that is electromagnetic, probably works on nuclear principles, and gives off energy whose load cannot be controlled. He offers it as a what-if, drawing on people he names only as Towns and Brown, to suggest how such a device might behave and why it could be hard to handle.
